result.brief: 提出基于预训练视频DiT的G-buffer几何先验条件注入与两阶段LoRA适配的仿真到真实视频翻译框架，并发布带G-buffer的驾驶视频数据集GenReal。
result.reason: G-buffer-conditioned video diffusion for sim-to-real translation; contributes video generation conditioning and a driving video dataset, though no new representation or world-model contribution.
